testHarness.existingFourTests: The existing four Google-sample tests observe request coordination and legal-choice state. Optional ATT denial handling does not demonstrate ATT Allow or Tarot's remotely configured IDFA message if the sample app does not supply it.

attReset.verifiedBy: Public Apple DocC JSON read on 2026-10-29
attReset.toolchainNote: Current XCUIAutomation module metadata says Xcode16.3. The API previously lived in XCTest; confirm selected toolchain by compilation, not by treating module migration as the historical API introduction.

testHarness.resetLimits: UMP reset does not reset ATT. Verify actual starting status after XCTest reset; restricted system state may remain restricted. Upgrade case must not reset either production consent or user data.
testHarness.observability: Capture screenshots, current ATT enum, UMP eligibility, actual request count, policy values and privacy report; never log raw IDFA, complete TCString, secrets or personal identifiers.
testHarness.requestEvidenceLimit: Banner-load counters and TCF observations are not proof of transport flags, Google buyer behavior or absence of tracking.

manifestDecision.observedAppManifest: NSPrivacyTracking=false; NSPrivacyCollectedDataTypes empty; UserDefaults reason CA92.1. Third-party SDK manifests carry their own collection declarations.
manifestDecision.observedGMAManifest: Pinned GMA12.14 declares DeviceID used for tracking but the inspected manifest lacks top-level NSPrivacyTracking/NSPrivacyTrackingDomains.
manifestDecision.appleRule: NSPrivacyTracking applies to app OR third-party SDK tracking. Apple TN3182 says true plus actual tracking domains for tracking connections; TN3181 says true with empty array is invalid.
manifestDecision.recommendedAction: Do not certify false merely because the SDK performs collection. Determine actual relevant tracking domains from exact SDK/traffic or vendor guidance and reconcile the aggregate archive report. Do not fabricate a host or add all Google domains. Parent owns implementation and final decision.
manifestDecision.whyGuessesHarm: iOS blocks requests to declared tracking domains without ATT; a guessed broad/dual-purpose host could disable contextual ads or consent traffic. Apple discusses separating mixed tracking/nontracking hosts; the SDK supplier controls these endpoints.

skadnetwork.scope: Adding applicable SKAdNetwork IDs from Google's current documented buyer list enables Apple install attribution for existing AdMob demand. It does not install a network SDK or configure a mediation group.
skadnetwork.condition: Apple specifies IDs for networks the app works with. Preserve the exact official source/date/list in evidence; do not copy an unrelated aggregator or claim every listed network has served Tarot.
skadnetwork.privacy: SKAdNetwork attribution can work without IDFA and is distinct from ATT-authorized cross-company tracking. Adding the list does not authorize optional buyers, adapters or broad identifier sharing.

releaseGate: Verify configured message routing on the exact pinned SDK and exact app; Google sample alone is insufficient.
Resolve manifest/domain question without inventing endpoints or invalid true+empty array.
Confirm archive privacy report and final Apple answers, bind version/build/commit, and read back public policy after authorized update.
Do not activate remote IDFA on the shared production app ID before legacy compatibility and disclosure rollout are resolved.
Keep source prepared, binary built, native tests, TestFlight, App Review submission and public release as separate evidence states.
